plugin.description: Send messages to your Claude conversations and Claude Code sessions. With no chat named, starts a new Claude chat, or sends to the default Claude chat or Claude Code session chosen in settings. Supports chat nicknames. Sign in in settings.

actions.name: send_to_agent
actions.description: Send a message to one of the user's Claude chats: a regular Claude conversation or a Claude Code session. chat_id is an instanceId from agent/chats, a nickname, or part of a title, to send there; "new" always starts a new regular Claude chat; omit it to follow settings (a new Claude chat or the default chat). Returns a receipt, not Claude's answer. Do not automatically retry an uncertain delivery or conflict.

message.description: What to tell Claude, without the "tell Claude" instruction itself.

chat_id.description: Name a chat to send there: its instanceId from agent/chats, its nickname, or part of its title. Use "new" to start a new regular Claude chat. Omit to follow settings (a new Claude chat or the default chat).
